name: Oath of Conquest
description: A legacy paladin subclass from Xanathar's Guide to Everything.

grants.name: Channel Divinity
grants.description: Gain the Conquering Presence and Guided Strike Channel Divinity options. You can expend one Channel Divinity use to activate either option.

grants.name: Conquering Presence
grants.description: As an action, chosen creatures you can see within 30 feet make a Wisdom save. On a failure, a creature is Frightened of you for 1 minute and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

grants.name: Guided Strike
grants.description: After making an attack roll but before learning whether it hits, expend Channel Divinity to add +10 to the roll.

grants.name: Oath Spells
grants.description: Always have the Oath of Conquest spells prepared at their listed Paladin levels; they do not count against the number of spells you prepare.

grants.name: Tenets of Conquest
grants.description: The oath emphasizes extinguishing resistance, ruling with uncompromising strength, and continually becoming strong enough to retain authority.

grants.name: Aura of Conquest
grants.description: While conscious, a creature Frightened of you that starts its turn within 10 feet has Speed 0 and takes psychic damage equal to half your Paladin level. The radius becomes 30 feet at Paladin level 18.

grants.name: Scornful Rebuke
grants.description: Whenever a creature hits you with an attack while you are not Incapacitated, it takes psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier, minimum 1.

grants.name: Invincible Conqueror
grants.description: As an action, transform for 1 minute: gain resistance to all damage, make one additional attack whenever taking the Attack action, and score critical hits with melee weapon attacks on 19 or 20. Regain use after a Long Rest.
